title: concussion@school - Mechanisms, management and outcomes of school-associated concussions in Paderborn
summary:
Children and adolescents after concussion often show individual complaints and symptoms that can lead to restrictions in everyday school life. 
The aim of the study is to systematically document injury management, mechanisms and the process of returning to everyday school life. Based on this data, recommendations for school reintegration after a concussion are to be derived. Another goal of the study is to raise awareness of school-associated concussions and to promote appropriate treatment of affected pupils.

interventions.name: Children and adolescents from Paderborn (Germany) who have suffered a concussion in the context of school.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Medically diagnosed concussion that occurred in the context of school (journey to school, everyday school life (break), school sports)
Exclusion criteria:
Participation declined
